newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Kelani up on good tea sector growth.
newsitem.headline: Kelani up on good tea sector growth.

text.p: Kelani Valley Plantations Ltd rose 3.7 percent, or 0.75 cents, to 21 rupees on local institutional buying in Friday morning trade, brokers said.
"The tea sector is doing very well which has been shown in good six-month results," one local institutional broker said.
Sri Lanka's tea prices have been at near record levels in recent months, which have resulted in sharp increases in net profits of plantation firms trading in Colombo.
Plantation firms being privatised have also fetched record prices. A 51-percent-stake in Balangoda Plantations Ltd was sold for a record 420.75 million rupees on Friday.
